Description: CloudWatch Dashboards to visualize Step Function resources. Both dashboards leverage Dashboard Variables to filter on the desired resources. Dashboard ‘Step_Function_All_Resources' visualizes ALL resources in the target region. Dashboard ‘Step_Function_Individual_Resources' provides additional filters to isolate a specific Step Function.

DefaultRegion.Description: Select the default region hosting the Step Functions to be monitored.

StateMachineArn.Description: Default Step Function ARN to be monitored.
